name: Four-Herb Wellness Tea Blend
service: OEM / ODM / Private Label Manufacturing / Custom Herbal Blends / Custom Packaging / Custom Labels
formats: Whole & Sliced Herbs / Individual Jars / Multi-Jar Gift Sets / Bulk Supply
description: A traditional botanical tea combination featuring four selected ingredients: ginseng slices, goji berries, codonopsis slices, and licorice root. The ingredients are presented in visible whole or sliced form and can be brewed together to create a naturally smooth and gently sweet herbal beverage for everyday enjoyment. Suitable for home, office, and daily tea routines. Ingredient ratios, jar sizes, packaging, labels, and gift-box combinations can be customized according to private-label customer requirements. OEM/ODM and bulk supply services are available.
